chosen.label: MilitaryAttackEvent
chosen.definition: An offensive action by military forces against an enemy or target.
chosen.justification: None of the schema.org candidates are appropriate for a military attack event. 'Event' is the correct parent for this type.

examples: Iranian attack on US site in Jordan
Iranian strikes on Kuwait and Saudi Arabia
Iran targeted F-15s, drone sites, helicopter facility
US struck sites along Strait of Hormuz

candidates.label: DeliveryEvent
candidates.comment: An event representing the delivery of an item, typically a product or package. Also called Shipping event, package delivery, consignment event. Examples: A package arriving at its destination, a food delivery being completed, a furniture delivery appointment. Distinct from Order, which is the request for items, not the delivery itself.
